ui.teamBridge.schedule.edit_failed.en: Your change was not confirmed. Your edits are kept here; review them and try again.
ui.teamBridge.schedule.edit_failed.target: 未能确认更改。你的修改已保留在此处，请检查后重试。

ui.teamBridge.schedule.edit_conflict.en: This message changed on another device. The latest version is shown with your changes kept where they don't clash. Review it and try again.
ui.teamBridge.schedule.edit_conflict.target: 此消息已在另一台设备上被更改。现显示最新版本，并在不冲突之处保留了你的更改。请检查后重试。

ui.teamBridge.schedule.edit_gone.en: This message was cancelled or has already been sent, so it can no longer be changed.
ui.teamBridge.schedule.edit_gone.target: 此消息已取消或已发送，无法再更改。

notes: 你 register, full-width ，。 punctuation; 设备 per glossary; 你的 kept deliberately in edit_failed/edit_conflict to contrast the author's edits with the server version (catalogue precedent: '你的修改会保留'); '请检查后重试' matches '请先刷新再重试'. See N1.

findings.summary: '此消息已在另一台设备上被更改' uses the 被 passive; the zh-CN style guide asks for verb-forward phrasing and cites '你的会话已被保存' as the shape to avoid. '此消息已在另一台设备上更改' (or '已在另一台设备上修改') reads more natively. Meaning, register and punctuation are otherwise correct.
findings.disposition: open - correctness-preserving; follow-up for the translator, not a blocker
